files.cached: Refresh failed; showing previously loaded entries.
files.limit: Display limited to 400 entries; collapse folders to see more.
files.snapshot: Saved image files; running changes appear after saving. Select a file for metadata.
images.title: Images
images.hint: Immutable filesystem snapshots, not running VMs. Includes image pages, lane checkpoints and results from the latest 100 operations; not an exhaustive account inventory.
compact.rawMetrics: Raw server resource statistics; units and aggregation unconfirmed. Not live utilization.
compact.search: Search loaded images by tag, UUID or lane
snapshots.title: Snapshot
snapshots.following: Following the lane head. Lists up to 20 recorded snapshots.
snapshots.readonly: Browsing a fixed snapshot; this does not change the lane head.
history.scope: Recent operations visible to this credential; counts reflect loaded records.
history.confirm: Clear panel history through now? Cloud operations and images are not deleted and tasks are not stopped.
lane.confirmDrop: Remove global lane {name}? It disappears from all sessions; image files remain.
images.noDelete: The current interface exposes no image deletion. Dropping a lane keeps its images.
detail.unknownMethod: This historical record has no call method; it cannot be recovered from the UUID.
preview.title: File preview
preview.skipped: Preview supports ordinary text files up to 256 KiB; binary files, symlinks and unknown sizes are not previewed.
taskView.encoded: Encoded output; expand raw response to inspect.
tasks.empty: No result yet; opening the pane queries the latest remote task.
tasks.saved: Result snapshot returned; files can be reused
tasks.temporary: Disposable run: file changes are not saved as a new snapshot
tasks.noSnapshot: Save requested, but no new snapshot returned yet; execution may be incomplete or files unchanged
tasks.laneAdvanced: Lane {name} now points to this image
tasks.cpu: Raw CPU statistic: {n} (unit unconfirmed; — means unavailable)
tasks.memory: Raw memory statistic: {n} (unit unconfirmed; — means unavailable)
tasks.logsNotice: Logs and results may be truncated by the server; this is not a live log stream.
browse.missing: Path or image unavailable: {path}. Return to root to check this snapshot.
pane.title: Sandbox
pane.server.refused: contree server: connected, but the API refused the key or project: {message}
pane.server.noAccess: contree server: connected, but this key may not use Sandboxes yet (missing: {missing}). Sandboxes are enabled per project by Nebius; check again once they are.
pane.server.hint: Save the Nebius Token Factory API key on the Models page, set the project in Settings → Plugins & Mods → nebius, and install uv so that uvx can start the server. A change takes effect after Velloc restarts.
pane.lanes.empty: No lanes yet. Ask the agent to start one (sandbox_lane_new).
